Northbank Community Garden — Important Notice

Please note that the north gate will be closed on Saturday 18 April from 9 am to 2 pm while we repair a leaking water pipe. During this time, please use the east entrance to enter and leave the garden. We apologise for any inconvenience and appreciate your patience while this essential repair is completed.

The seed swap has been moved to Sunday 19 April at 11 am. Please bring any seeds you would like to share or swap, and join us at the usual gathering area. If you have questions about the seed swap, please ask a committee member.

Volunteers are still needed for the repair and garden tasks. Please bring your own gloves; tools will be supplied. Mina is coordinating volunteers, so please check in with her when you arrive. Thank you to everyone who can help—your support keeps Northbank Community Garden thriving.
